name: EM FDTD
description: Real-time 3D FDTD electromagnetic simulation of the open board, with an animated field view.

actions.name: Simulate (EM FDTD)
actions.description: Select two pads (the port: RF pad first, then its ground pad) and start the simulation right away in the solver window (opened, or refreshed if already open).

actions.name: EM FDTD window
actions.description: Open the solver window on its preview screen (settings and estimate) for this board, or bring it forward if it is open. No pad selection needed; the previous port is kept. Does not start a run.

actions.name: EM FDTD farm
actions.description: Open the solver window on its Farm tab: turn the GPU farm on or off, pair machines, see devices and jobs. Does not start a run. The farm is off until you turn it on.
